model_annotations.Bulgarian: Графиката представя стойности на точност за четири различни метода – DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO и PPO+Self-reflection – приложени към три набора от данни: Mathverse, MMLU и Physics. Хоризонталната ос показва категориите (наборите от данни), подредени в реда Mathverse, MMLU и Physics. Вертикалната ос представлява точността в проценти (%), с линеен мащаб, вариращ от 50% до 62% и интервал на отметките от 2%. Всяка категория има четири съседни стълба, представляващи всеки от методите. Стълбовете за DAPO+Self-reflection са сини, за DAPO – оранжеви, за SRPO – червени, а за PPO+Self-reflection – зелени. За Mathverse, стълбовете имат приблизителни стойности: DAPO+Self-reflection – 56.5%, DAPO – 53%, SRPO – 52.5% и PPO+Self-reflection – 54.5%. За MMLU, стълбовете имат приблизителни стойности: DAPO+Self-reflection – 57.5%, DAPO – 55%, SRPO – 54% и PPO+Self-reflection – 56%. За Physics, стълбовете имат приблизителни стойности: DAPO+Self-reflection – 61.5%, DAPO – 59%, SRPO – 58% и PPO+Self-reflection – 60%. Стълбовете са групирани по категории, като всеки стълб в групата представлява различен метод. Няма визуално подчертани стълбове.
model_annotations.Chinese: 这张柱状图旨在展示不同模型在三个数据集上的准确率。横轴表示数据集类别，包括“Mathverse”、“MMLU”和“Physics”，类别按此顺序排列。纵轴表示准确率（%），线性刻度，范围从50%到62%，刻度间隔为2%。图表中包含四组柱状图，每组代表一种模型： “DAPO+Self-reflection”（蓝色）、“DAPO”（浅蓝色）、“SRPO”（橙色）和“PPO+Self-reflection”（绿色）。每组柱状图对应于三个数据集，每个数据集对应一个柱子。例如，“Mathverse”数据集下，“DAPO+Self-reflection”模型的准确率约为56.5%， “DAPO”模型的准确率约为54.5%， “SRPO”模型的准确率约为52.5%， “PPO+Self-reflection”模型的准确率约为55%。在“Physics”数据集下，“DAPO+Self-reflection”模型的准确率最高，约为61%，而“SRPO”模型的准确率最低，约为55%。所有柱子均未进行特殊强调，例如加粗、突出显示或注释。
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy values for different models—DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, SRPO, and PPO—across three datasets: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis represents the datasets, labeled “Mathverse,” “MMLU,” and “Physics” in that order, with no apparent sorting. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, displays a linear scale ranging from 50% to 62%, with tick marks at 2% intervals. For each dataset, there are five bars representing the accuracy of each model. The “DAPO+Self-reflection” bars are light blue, with heights of approximately 55.5%, 57%, and 61.5% for Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics, respectively. The “GRPO” bars are orange, measuring approximately 53%, 55%, and 59.5% for the same datasets. “PPO+Self-reflection” is represented by bars with diagonal stripes, with heights of roughly 56.5%, 56.5%, and 58% across the three datasets. The “SRPO” bars are a solid orange color, with heights of about 54.5%, 54.5%, and 55% for Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. Finally, the “PPO” bars are green, with heights of approximately 55%, 57%, and 60.5%. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
model_annotations.German: Das Säulendiagramm stellt die Genauigkeit verschiedener Modelle in drei Datensätzen dar. Die horizontale Achse zeigt die Kategorien „Mathverse“, „MMLU“ und „Physics“ an, in dieser Reihenfolge von links nach rechts. Die vertikale Achse, beschriftet mit „Accuracy (%)“, stellt einen linearen Wertebereich von 50% bis 62% dar, mit einem Tick-Abstand von 2%. Für jede Kategorie gibt es vier Säulen, die jeweils ein anderes Modell repräsentieren: „DAPO+Self-reflection“ (blau), „DAPO“ (hellblau), „SRPO“ (orange) und „PPO+Self-reflection“ (grün). Die Säulen sind gruppiert, wobei jede Gruppe die Genauigkeit der vier Modelle für einen bestimmten Datensatz darstellt. Die Säule für „DAPO+Self-reflection“ in „Physics“ erreicht einen Wert von ungefähr 61%, während die Säule für „SRPO“ in „Mathverse“ einen Wert von ungefähr 53% aufweist. Die Säulen sind nicht in einer bestimmten Reihenfolge innerhalb jeder Gruppe sortiert. Es gibt keine visuell hervorgehobenen Säulen.
